directive:
Replace full observational faithfulness in the primary population class by causal minimality:
∀ i and every j ∈ pa_G(i), V_i ⫫̸ V_j ∣ V_{pa_G(i) \ {j}}.
Define the corresponding positive normalized C³ derivative-sign stratum. Prove edge separation open dense there, and state exact ratio decoding and DAG recovery on its cover-separated subset. Keep full faithfulness only as an immediate corollary.

In lem:analytic-edge-perturbation, replace the all-d-separation faithfulness-openness argument with finitely many edgewise conditional-dependence functionals. Their positivity is exactly causal minimality and is open under C² perturbations. The sparse endpoint need not be minimal for every edge because only sufficiently small perturbations of the starting mechanism must stay in the stratum.

For parent pruning, prove: if an admissible A omits parent b, weak union gives V_i ⊥ V_b | V_{B_i \ {b}}; local Markov gives V_i ⊥ V_{B_i \ pa(i)} | V_{pa(i)}; strict positivity plus graphoid intersection yields V_i ⊥ V_b | V_{pa(i) \ {b}}, contradicting causal minimality. Thus admissible iff it contains all parents without full faithfulness. In compatible-representation uniqueness, replace the faithful-skeleton argument by uniqueness of this parent-pruning functional under the common recovered topological order, giving identical parent sets.

Correct the anchor scope everywhere. The published von Kügelgen Theorems 3.2/3.4 use C¹ densities fully supported on ℝⁿ and C¹ diffeomorphic mixing with merely nonzero own-ratio derivative. This note uses positive C³ compact-cube mechanisms and C² mixing. Nonzero derivative and fixed sign agree on connected support, and product-interval support is an allowed anchor relaxation, but the note is still a smoother compact-support specialization; forward identification does not transfer to the full published class. Do not claim the entire anchor conjecture is settled.

Synchronize tldr, project_justification.{gap,niche,fill}, related_work, theorem commentary, comparator table, core prose, and Honest Scope to say exactly in substance: “one unknown-target intervention per node solves arbitrary-dimensional nonlinear CRL on an open-dense set of smooth compact-support causal-minimal derivative-sign mechanisms”; characterize the anchor relation as “a strict intervention-count improvement on a broad smooth compact-support specialization, not a theorem over the entire published ℝⁿ/C¹ class.”

Preserve the validated non-laundering boundaries: derive cover separation as open dense; Gaussian MMD remains only the observable law-separation device; keep the finite-sample theorem conditional on its ratio-error event; keep oeq:generated-rank-frontier explicitly open.
